parameters.query: SELECT c.*, c.custom_fields, c.tags, c.lead_score, c.lead_status, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('type', la.activity_type, 'data', la.activity_data, 'at', la.created_at)) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id ORDER BY la.created_at DESC LIMIT 20) as recent_activities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'email_opened' AND la.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as opens_30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'email_clicked' AND la.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as clicks_30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'page_view' AND la.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as pageviews_30d FROM contacts c WHERE c.id = {{ $json.body.contact_id || $json.contact_id }}
